arms.F_check: rows scored under calibration_epoch 0 (before the first swap) must give F = R in >= 99.9 % of windows; otherwise F is reported as not reproducible and the comparison is not made

expectations.R_system_primary: recall >= 95 %, precision >= 95 %, idle-control positive <= 5 %, p95 kernel -> first alert (window end) <= 3 s (< 2 s preferred); met = all four; Wilson 95 % CI
expectations.installation: scripts/analysis/live_recalibration_check.py: every live tree_p, support_p and joint_p under an applied epoch equals the independent rebuild in >= 99.9 % of rows on every worker; the three workers swap the same array sizes for the same hour; no refresh failure; no worker restart or OOM (MemoryMax 3 G)
expectations.burden_decision: normal span = first applied refresh -> capture end, campaign span excluded; episodes per replica-hour of R and F with a workload-clustered bootstrap 95 % CI of R - F (10,000 draws). R beats F (rule of calibration-strategies-v1) when its burden is >= 10 % lower AND recall (primary) not lower by more than 2 points AND idle control not higher by more than 1 point AND p95 not slower by more than 0.2 s
expectations.adoption: if R_system meets the four expectations and R beats F, the final system becomes ML with rolling-12-1 + tripwire; otherwise the final system stays as confirmed on 26/10 and the result is reported as it is

reported_without_threshold: burden of R and F per 6-hour block (does the gap grow as the bundle calibration ages?)
per refresh: calibration sizes per workload, workloads kept, build and apply time, worker memory
recall by attack rate for R and F

limitations_stated_in_advance: the campaign exclusion uses knowledge a deployment does not have; an attack inside the calibration window would loosen thresholds for up to 12 h
